detailed_description:
This is a strict interpolation between <Video 1> and <Video 2>, not a redesign or independent new scene. Preserve exactly the same character models, facial features, body proportions, costumes, hairstyles, colors, textures, lighting, environment, depth of field, animation behavior, and high-quality stylized 3D rendering. The generated clip should last approximately three seconds.

[Shot 1] The first frame exactly matches the final frame of <Video 1>. <Subject 2> stands on the left, leaning slightly toward the others with a worried open-mouthed expression. <Subject 1> stands near the center beside the sofa, holding her black wand upright. <Subject 3> is visible on the right in her white floral dress. The camera begins in the same frontal medium-wide position as <Video 1>.

<Subject 1> looks at <Subject 2>, and her expression gradually becomes angry. Her eyebrows lower and draw together, her eyes narrow, her cheeks tense, and her mouth settles into a displeased frown. She tightens both hands around the wand. Her facial changes follow the source video’s existing animation language without altering her face or age.

At 00:00.700, <Subject 1> forcefully lowers and rotates the wand from its upright position into a forward diagonal orientation. She shifts slightly toward the left foreground and aims the wand tip toward <Subject 2>. Her arms, shoulders, hair, hat, and layered dress move naturally with the gesture.

<Subject 2> reacts by widening his eyes and drawing his ears slightly backward. He bends his knees, lowers his body, and moves closer to the wand with nervous curiosity. His shoulder bag and jacket respond with natural secondary movement as he transitions smoothly from standing to the crouched posture shown at the beginning of <Video 2>.

At 00:01.400, a faint blue-purple light appears inside the sculpted tip of the wand. The magical light grows gradually rather than flashing abruptly. A concentrated blue core forms at the tip, surrounded by a soft violet halo. The glow creates subtle blue-purple reflections on <Subject 1>’s hands, face, pendant, and dress and on <Subject 2>’s snout, eyes, and jacket.

As the characters move, the camera performs one continuous, smooth motion: it slowly dollies forward, lowers slightly, and arcs gently toward the right. This transforms the wider frontal view from <Video 1> into the closer, lower angle used at the beginning of <Video 2>. There is no cut, dissolve, morph, or abrupt reframing.

<Subject 2> completes his crouch beside the wand and cautiously raises one hand toward its glowing tip. <Subject 1> grips the wand firmly with both hands and keeps her angry gaze directed downward. <Subject 3> remains stationary on the right; the camera movement gradually crops her until only the same portion of her white dress visible in <Video 2> remains in frame.

The final frame must precisely match the first frame of <Video 2>: <Subject 1> occupies the left foreground with an angry expression, holding the wand diagonally toward the center; its tip emits the same blue-purple glow; <Subject 2> crouches close to the wand at center-right with one hand approaching it; and only the lower portion of <Subject 3> is visible at the far-right edge. Character poses, gaze directions, camera position, framing, lighting, glow intensity, and object placement must converge exactly to <Video 2>.

Strict continuity constraints: no change of visual style; no character redesign; no face, age, proportion, costume, hairstyle, color, material, or environment changes; no added or removed characters; no teleporting limbs or objects; no duplicated wand or hands; no sudden camera cut; and no visible transition artifact at either connection point.

overall_soundscape:
Continue the same quiet indoor room tone and acoustic character found in the reference videos. Add subtle fabric, jacket, and shoulder-bag movement as the characters reposition. The wand produces a soft rising magical hum and a restrained crystalline shimmer as the blue-purple glow forms. <Subject 2> makes a quiet nervous inhale, but no character speaks. The sound must connect smoothly with the ending audio of <Video 1> and the opening audio of <Video 2> without a sudden volume or ambience change.
